_provenance: Encounter ecology from the UDirectorSubsystem vision. The director orchestrates stranger/trader/pirate cadence; the objective binds the ecology to two DESIGN LAWS — the first stranger of a generation CANNOT pay (Law 2: the lesson is taught through consequence), and pirates ONLY spawn during storms to the visibly rich. These are HARD gates, not tunables.

walls.concurrent_dots_p95_worst_low: The world MUST contain at least 2 active dots at the 95th percentile. Below 2 means the player walks through an empty desert — the director is not directing, it is sleeping. Malcolm's floor: 'active_dots [2, 24]'. This is the floor side.
walls.concurrent_dots_p95_worst_high: The world MUST NOT exceed 24 active dots at the 95th percentile. Above 24 means every stranger, trader, and pirate piles up faster than they resolve — the player is drowning in NPCs. Malcolm's ceiling: 'active_dots [2, 24]'. This is the ceiling side.
walls.pirate_gate_violations: Pirates MUST ONLY spawn in (rich, storm) conditions. ANY violation — naturalistic or probed — is a broken design rule. The vision's conditional is unconditional: 'if credits > 200 and storm_active'. This wall audits both bypass loci by direct probe of all four (wealth, storm) cells.
walls.first_stranger_paid_fraction: The first stranger of a generation MUST NEVER pay. Law 2: the Yard teaches you to help before it lets you trade. This is the first-stranger-can-pay bypass locus the wall catches — a reachable locus with a hard gate, per the dead-gene-trap doctrine.
walls.scenario_entropy_norm: Scenario diversity MUST stay above 0.50 normalized entropy. Below 0.50 means one or two needs dominate the encounter stream — every stranger wants oxygen, every trader sells oxygen. The director has 6 scenarios; using only 2 is a vending machine, not an ecology.
walls.encounter_gap_cv_mean: The gap between encounters MUST NOT be too bursty. CV above 2.0 means the player gets 4 encounters in 5 minutes then nothing for 2 hours. A director that poisson-clumps and then starves is an on/off switch, not a cadence.
